notes: Dev AUROC selects temperature independently by view; dev balanced accuracy selects threshold. Test sources never used for selection.
Primary: fixed v2 settings (single T=.3, paired T=.7). Secondary: exploratory best-on-cohort temperature sweep; no independent validation.
Reuse frozen baseline predictions on identical episodes. Robometer public uses its own eight-frame offline protocol, not PSI's four-point endpoint-excluded protocol.

WSM ABC single-view and paired inputs put the goal first, matching its saved ABC training recipe. Public single-view remains current-first, as trained in the generic robot group. Paired benchmarks provide one wrist, while the YAM training recipe has two. Older checkpoint results retain their published protocols. WSM FP4 and BF16 use identical inputs and the exact same source weights.

dense_public.density: Every frame in the released clips; original capture timestamps and denser original recordings are not available in this benchmark release.
